description:
Position Overview 
 We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy IRIS, an AI agent supporting the HFDP Data Integration project. IRIS will help users discover, connect, and understand product information across investigations, inspections, and recalls using enterprise data warehouse resources. The ideal candidate combines AI agent development expertise with strong data engineering skills, hands-on Tableau and Power BI experience, and working knowledge of Databricks.
  
 Key responsibilities 
 Develop IRIS’s agent architecture, conversational capabilities, workflows, and tool integrations.

 Translate business requirements into AI capabilities and measurable acceptance criteria.

 Connect IRIS to approved warehouse views, APIs, reference data, and documentation.

 Implement natural language querying, retrieval, and source-grounded responses.

 Integrate product-name matching and entity resolution to connect records across domains.

 Develop and maintain Tableau and Power BI dashboards and reports supporting product analysis and validation of IRIS results.

 Work with Tableau data sources and Power BI semantic models to maintain consistent business definitions and metrics.

 Use Databricks notebooks, SQL, and existing workflows to support data preparation, experimentation, and AI integration.

 Implement access controls, human review, error handling, and traceability.

 Build evaluations for response accuracy, retrieval relevance, tool execution, and task completion.

 Deploy and monitor AI services for reliability, performance, usage, and cost.

 Collaborate with domain experts, BI developers, data engineers, and architects; document solutions and mentor team members.

 

 Required qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 5+ years of relevant software, data, or AI engineering experience, including production AI delivery.

 Strong Python, SQL, API development, and software engineering skills.

 Hands-on experience developing LLM applications with tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval-augmented generation, and multi-step agent workflows.

 Experience integrating AI applications with enterprise databases and services.

 Hands-on experience with both Tableau and Power BI, including dashboard development, data modeling, calculations, and report validation.

 Familiarity with Tableau calculated fields and Power BI DAX and Power Query.

 Some practical Databricks experience, including notebooks, SQL, and working with existing data workflows.

 Experience with AI evaluation, automated testing, Git, CI/CD, and cloud deployment.

 Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical teams and business stakeholders.

  
 Preferred qualifications: 
 Experience with product entity resolution, semantic search, embeddings, and vector retrieval.

 Familiarity with Databricks Delta tables, PySpark, MLflow, or Unity Catalog.

 Experience with BI access controls, refresh processes, and performance optimization.

 Experience developing AI agents in enterprise or regulated environments.

 Familiarity with investigations, inspections, recalls, or regulatory data.

 Experience implementing source citations, human review workflows, and audit logging.

  
 Preferred: Databricks and AWS certification 

 SAIC®  is a premier mission integrator focused on advancing the power of technology and innovation to serve and protect our world. Our robust portfolio of offerings across the defense, space, intelligence, and civilian markets includes secure high-end solutions in mission IT, enterprise IT, engineering services, and professional services. We integrate emerging technology, rapidly and securely, into mission critical operations that modernize and enable critical national imperatives. 
 
 

 We are approximately 23,000 strong; driven by mission, united by purpose, and inspired by opportunities. SAIC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
